name: Eswatini Cars v1.1.1 — Status bar fix (navy background, visible icons)
body:
## What's fixed in v1.1.1

### Status bar icons now visible

In v1.1.0, the status bar (top area with battery, time, notifications) was masked white and the icons were invisible. This was because:
- `statusBarColor` was set to white
- Status bar icons are white by default
- White icons on white background = invisible

**Fix:** Changed `statusBarColor` to navy (#0a1834) — matching the app's CSS header color. Now:
- Status bar background = navy (matches the app header)
- Status bar icons = white (visible against navy)
- The status bar blends seamlessly with the app's navy header

This was tested in the staging APK (staging-v1.1.1) and confirmed working before publishing to production.

### Install

1. Download the `Eswatini-Cars.apk` asset below
2. Install it over your current v1.1.0 (no uninstall needed — same package, same signature, higher version code)
3. Open Eswatini Cars — the status bar should now be navy with visible white icons

### Verification

- Package: sz.co.eswatinicars.app
- Version: 1.1.1 (versionCode 10)
- Size: 3.30 MB
- Signed with SHA-1 69:DF:80:0E:83:22:DA:59:60:1E:E7:3F:55:EC:ED:FB:2C:75:50:B8 (same keystore as all previous versions)
- This is a NATIVE-only fix (styles.xml + colors.xml) — no website changes
